// REQ: LANG-2261 LANG-2262 LANG-2263 LANG-2264
//@version=5
indicator("Demo", overlay = true)
length = input.int(14, "Length")
// Moving averages
fast = ta.sma(close, length)
slow = ta.ema(close, length * 2)
cross = ta.crossover(fast, slow)
plot(fast, color = color.blue)
if cross and not na(slow)
    label.new(bar_index, high, "Buy", color = color.green)
